About Me

Walid Elonok, 1st year SDIA at FSR.

every elegant solution eventually creates a new, much worse problem.

I like taking photos of cats (among other things), and building stuff to kill time

i build weird software to kill time, and sometimes it turns into something useful. mostly offline protocols, audio dsp, agentic tooling and mobile ux. projects.

away from the keyboard: cats (i photograph them and collect cat facts), doodling, and soup. i make a lot of soup. yes, souphater.page. no, i don't hate soup.

Projects

stuff i build to kill time. all on github.

  • ditto

    record a voice note on android and it lands in whatever chat you're in. typing on glass sucks.

    kotlin / alpha

  • intel-arc-llm

    local llm inference tuned for intel arc igpus: vulkan, dp4a, speculative decoding.

    c++ / moving fast

  • gemwallet

    finance tracker for android. encrypted local db, no telemetry, works offline. optional api if you want sync.

    kotlin / almost done

  • agent-base

    a small agent loop with streaming, reasoning logs and human approval.

    typescript / shipping

  • bitnet

    android bluetooth mesh, plus internet sharing over bluetooth without root. it will break on you, that's the honest status.

    android / unfinished

  • tether-compass

    a web compass for long-distance couples. it lights up when you're facing each other.

  • discord-mcp

    an mcp server so an ai can read and talk in discord.

  • DirectMoutamadris

    check your moroccan grades without waiting on the slow portal.
